blogs.content:
Luxury bathroom design is changing.

Instead of treating sanitaryware, furniture, storage and accessories as separate elements, today's premium interiors are increasingly designed as complete architectural environments.

Falper's Living Bathroom™ concept reflects this evolution by bringing together furniture, materials, washbasins, storage systems and complementary elements into a unified design language.

Craftsmanship at the Core

Falper describes its production approach as working like an atelier, combining in-house carpentry and lacquering, skilled artisans and advanced technologies. Products are configured according to project requirements and selected materials.

This attention to detail allows Falper to create bathroom environments that feel highly considered and personalised.

Premium Materials

Falper works with a range of carefully selected materials, including:

  • Natural marble
  • Curved wood
  • Lacquered finishes
  • Glass
  • Concrete
  • Cristalplant
